title: ZK TicTacToe
tagline: A simple Tic-Tac-Toe frontend for Tic-Tac-Toe in Aleo! All done in ZK!
description: This project builds a 2 player tic-tac-toe game that uses Aleo programs as the backend. It makes use of Leo and the Aleo compiler, and uses the React starter template to make a front end interface for the user to use. It is really simple, but should be an illustrative example of how easy it is to incorporate ZK into web apps!
how_its_made: The project is made using React, Tailwind, and Leo. I used the creater-aleo-app example to build this project. The Leo compiler is still in its early stages and there is no main net yet, so I mainly just tested locally and used i32 for all data types. The main problems I faced were due to lack of documentation and support at the hackathon venue.
